request.raw_text: Add bigger amount of cylindrical holes into the red platforms to decrease their weights. Amount of patterns can be chosen by editor.
parameter_words: Amount of patterns can be chosen by editor

aim.primary_aim: Provide the red platforms with more cylindrical holes, using an editor-selected number of patterns, so that the platforms weigh less.

functional_design_intentions.name: Platform weight reduction
functional_design_intentions.description: Decrease the weight of the red platforms by increasing the amount of material-removing cylindrical holes.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: cylindrical holes in the red platforms

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: all non-targeted model geometry and the red platforms' geometry outside the added holes
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve non-targeted geometry and existing platform interfaces under a minimum-change rule while permitting the requested added holes.

geometry.description: The red platforms contain a greater amount of cylindrical holes than before, arranged using a number of patterns selected by the editor.

functions.name: Weight reduction
functions.description: The added cylindrical holes reduce the weight of the red platforms.

behaviors.name: Reduced mass under gravity
behaviors.description: The additional hole volume removes platform material, resulting in lower platform mass and weight than before.

validation_criteria.description: Cylindrical holes exist in the red platforms.
The final amount of cylindrical holes in the red platforms is greater than the pre-edit amount.
The number of hole patterns matches the amount selected by the editor.
The added holes provide weight reduction for the red platforms.
The red platforms have lower mass and weight than before because of the additional hole volume.
Non-targeted geometry and platform geometry outside the added holes remain unchanged.

unresolved_requirements.description: The red platforms are identified only by color, with no exact section or feature IDs.
candidate_interpretations: All platform-like geometry displayed in red
A subset of red platform-like geometry intended by the engineer

unresolved_requirements.description: No numerical hole count or pattern count is specified; only an increase in holes and editor discretion over the amount of patterns are stated.
candidate_interpretations: Any hole count greater than the existing count, using an editor-selected pattern count
Additional repeated patterns of cylindrical holes, with each pattern's population determined from the existing model

unresolved_requirements.description: Hole diameter, depth or termination, spacing, pattern arrangement, and placement boundaries are not specified.
candidate_interpretations: Match the dimensions and termination of existing cylindrical holes
Distribute the holes in one or more editor-selected arrangements
